# PatSons Foods Goa

> Premier manufacturer and supplier of authentic Goan food products, syrups, fruit crushes, cocktail mixers, pickles, sauces, and dessert jellies.

## Business Profile
- Name: PatSons Foods
- Location: Morjim, Goa, India
- Phone/WhatsApp: +91 7758943614
- Website: https://patsonsfoods.com
- Delivery Areas: Goa statewide delivery, pan-India wholesale supply.

## Key Product Categories
- Syrups & Cordials: Blue Curacao, Grenadine, Kokum, Ginger Lime, Rose, Green Apple.
- Fruit Crushes: Strawberry, Mango, Butterscotch, Blueberry, Kiwi.
- Authentic Goan Specialities: Pure Kokum extract, Pachak Appetizer Crush, Cashew Apple Syrup.
- Sauces & Condiments: Chilly Sauce, Tomato Ketchup, Goan Pickles.
- Dessert Jellies: Mix Fruit Jelly Sweets, Agar Agar Halwa.

## Ordering & Wholesale Inquiries
Customers and HoReCa businesses (Hotels, Restaurants, Cafes) can request bulk quotations and direct orders via WhatsApp and online quotation carts. Minimum quantity auto-approval threshold: 10 units.
